# Clockchain Shadow

> A flight recorder for AI agents. An agent records each step of a task, Shadow signs the steps and anchors their fingerprints (hashes) on a ledger, and anyone with the record's link can check that nothing changed afterwards. Testnet only. This is a hosted MCP server, so there is nothing to install.

To connect and record a task, do this:

1. Read the server's own instructions: https://mcp.clockchain.network/shadow/connect
2. Connect over streamable HTTP to https://mcp.clockchain.network/shadow/mcp. On claude.ai, use https://mcp.clockchain.network/shadow/chat/mcp instead.
3. Sign in with OAuth (a free testnet account, no email). Or, if you run code, sign in with your own Ed25519 key and DPoP. The connect page gives the fields.
4. Record:
   - start with shadow_start_session;
   - add each step with shadow_record;
   - finish with shadow_close_session;
   - give the person the viewer link.
5. Signed in with your own key? Sign in this order:
   1. record your steps;
   2. call shadow_checkpoint (count is your last step's seq; head is its hash);
   3. call shadow_sign_checkpoint;
   4. call shadow_close_session;
   5. call shadow_sign_checkpoint again.
   If you lose a hash, shadow_checkpoint returns the one still waiting, even after the close.
6. Record only synthetic or redacted content. Anyone with the viewer link can read every step.

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): connect, record, share and check, for every client.
